**Premise reading, all four families** · read at 2026-11-23T10:31Z on objectstack main `9348f02b`, against the hosted source it was inventoried from (cloud main `777e8e2`, `packages/service-ai-studio/src/verify/graph-lint.ts`, read only)

Card thread for claim 7097943444. Order: one PR per family, Flows first. Nothing from #34776 (PR #35244) overlaps this card's lines: that batch shipped node-type executors, approval decision edges, http timeouts, `initialStates` and action bindings. Lines below marked **covered** landed through other work since the inventory.

### Flows (built in this card's first PR)

| # | Line on the card | Verdict on main | Evidence | Plan |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| F1 | condition or field value uses a select option's label | **holds** | no rule compares a start condition or a CRUD `fields` literal with the options; the record validator refuses an off-list value at run time (`objectql/src/validation/record-validator.ts:1892`, `invalid_option`), so the step fails the run | two rule positions: start condition (label quoted, value not), CRUD write of a literal that is not an option value |
| F2 | record-change start with no object | **holds, consequence corrected** | the binding passes `object: undefined` (`service-automation/src/plugin-extension-api.ts:254`), and an undefined hook target registers on **every** object (`objectql/src/engine-top-level.ts:3863`): the flow fires on every object's write, it does not bind to nothing | error, message says what really happens |
| F3 | self-retriggering flow guarded only by a boolean it writes | **refuted on main** | both halves of the failure are fixed: the engine's re-entry guard keyed `flow::record` stops the nested re-fire (`service-automation/src/engine.ts:3208`), and driver-sql reads a stored `1/0` back as a boolean (`drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver-column-creation.ts:980`), so `is_x != true` trips | not built |
| F4a | time-relative trigger shadowed by a `record-*` triggerType | **holds** | `resolveFlowTriggerKind` answers `record_change` first (`spec/src/automation/flow-trigger-kind.ts:76`) | error |
| F4b | filter / maxRecords beside the descriptor | **holds** | the sweep reads only `config.timeRelative.filter`; the binding forwards `schedule` and `condition` (`plugin-extension-api.ts:271-293`) | error |
| F4c | unknown swept object | **covered** | `flow-trigger-unknown-object` on `config.timeRelative.object` (`lint/src/validate-flow-trigger-readiness.ts:793`) | nothing to add |
| F4d | swept field missing or not a date | **holds** | no rule reads `dateField` against the object | error |
| F5 | schedule with no timezone | **holds** | an absent `timezone` runs in UTC (`triggers/trigger-schedule/src/schedule-trigger.ts:251`) | warning |
| F6 | subflow step naming a flow that does not exist | **holds** | no rule reads `subflow`/`map` `config.flowName`; the node fails at run time (`builtin/subflow-node.ts:175`) | see note 1 |
| F7a | date helper in a plain string | **holds** | a bare string in a value slot is a literal (`spec/src/automation/builtin-node-config.zod.ts:533`) | error on a `date`/`datetime` target |
| F7b | CEL faulting on a date-only value | **covered** | #34451: `timestamp(record.DATE_FIELD)` in a flow value envelope is refused under `date-text-call` (`lint/src/validate-expressions.ts:3189`, engine `registerFlow` the same) | nothing to add |
| F8 | after-create and after-update flows doing the same thing | **holds** | nothing compares flows | warning |

Note 1: the runtime publish gate judges a flow write over a snapshot whose `flows` holds only the written item (`authoring-rules.ts`, the `validateFlowTriggerReadiness` entry), so a call to another stored flow cannot be resolved there without a false refusal. F6 is CLI-side; same for F8, which needs two flows.

### Data model (later PR; read, not built)

| # | Line | Verdict | Evidence / where it would extend |
|---|---|---|---|
| D1 | count/total-named field typed as lookup | holds | no name-shaped rule beside `field/missing-value-domain` (`lint/src/data-model-rules.ts:1123`) |
| D2 | formula reading a summary with no configuration | **covered at the root** | `field/summary-without-operations` refuses the summary itself (`spec/src/kernel/functional-completeness.ts:110`); the finding does not name the dependent formula |
| D3 | summary whose child has no reference back | holds | `lintSummaryRollups` skips an unresolved child (`data-model-rules.ts:891`) |
| D4 | `reference` on a type that reads none | holds | the schema refuses only lookup/master_detail without it and `user` with a foreign one (`spec/src/data/field.zod.ts:3413`, `:3448`) |
| D5 | approval detail field editable while pending | holds, narrower | the record lock and `master_detail` child lock are runtime (`plugins/plugin-approvals/src/lifecycle-hooks.ts:522`); open cases are `lockRecord: false` and `lookup` children |

### Views, dashboards, app shell (later PR; read, not built)

| # | Line | Verdict | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| V1 | board grouped by a non-select field | holds | `kanban.groupByField` is checked for existence only (`validate-list-view-field-refs.ts:750`) |
| V2 | dashboard with no widgets | holds | `widgets` has no minimum (`spec/src/ui/dashboard.zod.ts:1797`) |
| V3 | view filter on a formula field | partial | only a dotted path through a formula head is reported (`validate-list-view-field-refs.ts:1148`); the engine refuses every formula filter |
| V4 | object no nav reaches / app with no nav / object with no view | holds | nav rules check targets and servability only; an object with no view falls back to an `all` tab |

### Seeds and actions (later PR; read, not built)

| # | Line | Verdict | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| S1 | seed key that is not a field | partial | `defineSeed` refuses unknown keys; the runtime save door checks only `externalId` (`metadata-protocol/src/protocol-save-door-refusals.ts:1063`) |
| S2 | seed / flow node / action on an object that does not exist | partial | seeds: `defineStack` and the save door; actions: `defineStack` only; **flow CRUD nodes: nothing** (`validate-flow-node-writes.ts` skips an unknown object). The flow-node part goes with the data-model or seeds PR, not this one |
| S3 | action body writes without the write capability | holds | `validate-action-body-writes.ts` parses the calls but does not compare them with the declared capabilities |
